Class JacksonCborDecoder

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.http.codec.JacksonCodecSupport<tools.jackson.dataformat.cbor.CBORMapper>
org.springframework.http.codec.AbstractJacksonDecoder<tools.jackson.dataformat.cbor.CBORMapper>
org.springframework.http.codec.cbor.JacksonCborDecoder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Decoder<Object>, HttpMessageDecoder<Object>
public class JacksonCborDecoder extends AbstractJacksonDecoder<tools.jackson.dataformat.cbor.CBORMapper>
Decode bytes into CBOR and convert to Objects with Jackson 3.x.

流解码当前不受支持。

Since:
7.0
Author:
Sebastien Deleuze
See Also:
  • JacksonCborEncoder
  • Add CBOR support to WebFlux

  • Method Details

    • decode

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<Object> decode(Publisher<DataBuffer> input, ResolvableType elementType, @Nullable MimeType mimeType, @Nullable Map<String,Object> hints)
      描述从接口复制：Decoder
      将 `DataBuffer` 输入流解码为 `T` 的 Flux。
      Specified by:
      `decode` 接口 `Decoder<Object>` 中
      Overrides:
      `decode` 在类 `AbstractJacksonDecoder<tools.jackson.dataformat.cbor.CBORMapper>` 中
      Parameters:
      input - 要解码的 DataBuffer 输入流
      elementType - 输出流中元素的预期类型；此类型必须已先前传递给Decoder.canDecode(ResolvableType, MimeType)方法，且该方法必须返回true。
      mimeType - 与输入流关联的 MIME 类型（可选）
      hints - 关于如何进行解码的附加信息
      Returns:
      带有解码元素的输出流
